svg.text: Solution Architecture — grounded AI development for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
.NET 10 · Spectre.Console.Cli · single shell tool · self-contained or dotnet run
Every write is journaled (FIFO) — undo --steps N replays it in reverse through the same write path.
X++ Knowledge — one corpus, three delivery paths
skills/_source/*.md (19 topics: CoC · SysDa · FormRun · select grammar · BP canon · labels · security · …)
→ embedded in the binary: knowledge list/get/search — lazy, section-scoped, ~30–60 tok per lookup
Data Access — bridge-first when available, index-first otherwise
live metadata → C# bridge · search & labels → SQLite FTS5
_source: "bridge" | "index" tag on every reply · auto-invalidate on write
non-Windows hosts fall back to the index automatically
opt-in: D365FO_BRIDGE_ENABLED=1 · Windows D365FO VM only
PackagesLocalDirectory — model XML (AOT, standard + ISV + custom)
